findings.evidence: `grep -n "IsProjectiveCover\." TauCeti/Algebra/Module/ProjectiveCover.lean` yields only `exists_surjective`, `bijective_of_comp_eq`, `exists_linearEquiv`, `postcomp`, `ker_le_jacobson`. Superfluous.lean:158 does state the parallel invariance on the other side (`@[simp] isSuperfluous_map_equiv_iff`), so the file develops one side of this pair and not the other; the roadmap target is stated as "unique up to isomorphism" (TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/QuiverRepresentations/README.md:289), making iso-invariance the operation in scope.
findings.fix: Add `IsProjectiveCover.comp_equiv` (or the `@[simp]` iff `isProjectiveCover_comp_equiv_iff : IsProjectiveCover (f ∘ₗ ↑e) ↔ IsProjectiveCover f`), proved from `Module.Projective.of_equiv`, `LinearMap.ker_comp`, and the `comap`-along-an-equivalence form of finding 2.
findings.issue: `exists_linearEquiv` hands back `e : P ≃ₗ[R] P'` with `f' ∘ₗ ↑e = f`, but no lemma says `IsProjectiveCover` is stable under such an `e`: there is no `IsProjectiveCover (f ∘ₗ (↑e : Q →ₗ[R] P))`. `postcomp` covers only composition on the target side, so a consumer transporting a cover along the very isomorphism this file produces must redo the three fields by hand.

findings.evidence: Reverse direction: `Submodule.map_comap_eq_of_surjective hf K : (K.comap f).map f = K` (used by this very proof at line 173) combined with `IsSuperfluous.map` (line 140) gives `IsSuperfluous (K.comap f) → IsSuperfluous K`, needing not even `hker`.
findings.fix: Strengthen to `isSuperfluous_comap_iff (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hker : IsSuperfluous (LinearMap.ker f)) : IsSuperfluous (K.comap f) ↔ IsSuperfluous K`, keeping `IsSuperfluous.comap` as the `mpr`; add the `@[simp]` equivalence special case dual to `isSuperfluous_map_equiv_iff`.
findings.issue: `IsSuperfluous.comap` is stated one-directionally, but under the same hypotheses the converse is immediate, so the characteristic restatement is missing. It is also the shape consumers actually meet: `LinearMap.ker_comp` produces `Submodule.comap f (LinearMap.ker g)`, and no lemma here (simp or otherwise) handles `IsSuperfluous (K.comap ↑e)` for an equivalence `e`.

summary: Surface is minimal, bodies are unexposed with the `_iff` restatement supplied, and the simp set is sound. Two characteristic lemmas are missing: `IsProjectiveCover` is never shown invariant under a linear equivalence even though `exists_linearEquiv` is the file's headline result, and `IsSuperfluous.comap` is one-directional although the converse follows from lemmas already in the file.
